business_summary.text: Aakash Exploration Services Limited is a service provider for oil and gas extraction.

corporate_actions.subject: Face Value Split (Sub-Division) - From Rs 10/- Per Share To Re 1/- Per Share

operating_notes.text: The company re-appointed M/s. Bimal Shah Associates as Internal Auditor for FY2026-27.
Bad debts of ₹3.66 Cr were adjusted in the cash flow statement for FY26.
NSE approved the reclassification of Deval Energy Resources Private Limited from Promoter Group to Public category.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹32.65 Cr (+26.7% YoY), net profit ₹1.88 Cr (+571.4% YoY).
Hemang N. Haria, Promoter & Whole Time Director, disclosed 66.54% promoter group shareholding in Aakash Exploration Services on March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
NSE approved the reclassification of Deval Energy Resources Private Limited from Promoter Group to Public category.
